name: domain-navigator
description: Turns an unfamiliar field into one self-contained Markdown domain map over about two weeks — a map to read, a carrier for cross-session memory, and an interface for any other AI.

displayDescription.zh: 从一个真实问题出发，两周画出一份自包含的领域地图，交给任何 AI 都能继续追问，也能留档给下一次续接。
displayDescription.en: Start from a real question and, in about two weeks, build a self-contained domain map you can hand to any AI and keep for yourself.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想学经济学，主要想知道为什么降价了也卖不动。
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to learn economics — mainly why a price cut still fails to sell.

quickPrompts.zh: 我想学经济学，主要想知道为什么降价了也卖不动。
quickPrompts.en: I want to learn economics — mainly why a price cut still fails to sell.

quickPrompts.zh: 我遇到一个实际问题，请帮我定位到相关领域，并解释关键概念之间的关系。
quickPrompts.en: Help me locate a real problem in its field and explain the key concept relationships.

quickPrompts.zh: 请把这一轮的内容更新进我的领域地图，标出当前学习位置和待展开的段落。
quickPrompts.en: Fold this round into my domain map, marking the current position and the sections still to expand.
